Name: Burrito Geode
Author: stardemod
Description:
This mod introduces highly anticipated new recipes: Geode Burritos crafted from Quartz and Amethyst Burritos crafted from Amethyst. Players will receive these recipes from Abigail via mail once their friendship level reaches a certain point.

Abigail, determined to showcase her culinary prowess to her skeptics, including her father and perhaps even Gordon Ramsay, presents the diverse flavors of Stardew Valley through these delightful creations.

The Geode Burrito recipe calls for:
[list]
[*]1 Quartz
[*]1 Tortilla
[*]1 Cheese

[/list]While the Amethyst Burrito recipe requires:
[list]
[*]1 Amethyst
[*]1 Tortilla
[*]1 Cheese
[/list]
It's important to note that not all villagers appreciate these dishes, but Abigail favors the Geode Burrito and adores the Amethyst Burrito.
